The skeletal structure of the shoulder and forelimbs is visible, along with parts of the ribcage and hindquarters in the background. checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The parietal-squamosal frill is massive and clearly extends well beyond the width of the facial portion of the skull, dominating the upper right of the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The frill appears as solid bone. While weathering affects the surface texture, the structural integrity matches the 'solid bone' description rather than fenestrated patterns seen in other ceratopsians.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Although the full side profile is obscured by the angle, the relative positioning of the shoulder girdle lower than the hip girdle is evident, consistent with the triceratops stance.
